name: Discrete Transistor — POTS

selection_hints: Select for surface-mount (SMD) discrete transistor applications requiring POTS footprint variants.

Note that all 5 parts in this cluster are classified under quality tier C.
avoid_when: Avoid when through-hole mounting or non-SMD mounting is required.
Do not use if the design requires a package family other than POTS.
Avoid if tier A or planner-visible verified parts are mandatory.
